rows.abstract: Recognizes the medicinal and commercial uses of our country's existing terrestial, aquatic and agricultural resources, thereby seeks to regulate their collection and utilization for the benefit of present and future generation of our citizens. Institutes a framework for the protection and utlization of the genetic materials found in the terrestial, aquatic and agricultural resources of the country.
